title: Understanding Bootstrap Sampling
text: Bootstrap sampling involves drawing samples with replacement from the dataset. This means that each sample can have repeated entries from the original dataset.

title: Null Hypothesis in Context
text: The null hypothesis states that the parameter of interest, in this case, $$\theta_0$$, is equal to zero. We are testing if there is no intercept in the relationship between $$critic_{1's}$$ rating and the skater's self-rating.

title: Using L2 Loss
text: L2 loss, also known as least squares loss, is used to minimize the sum of the squares of the differences between the observed and predicted values.

title: Evaluating the Statement
text: Given the use of bootstrap samples and the null hypothesis that $$\theta_0=0$$, is the statement about the inference process true or false?
